title: data_provenance.json
description: The provenance record of a capsule, as rmoriebricklayer reads it: loadprov() parses it, vrfcps() verifies the data against it. Fields other than those listed are allowed and ignored by the checks.

kind.description: What the capsule holds; "ledger" marks a proof ledger (ldgrread()), whose rows rmbl verify adds (ldgrchk()).

synthetic.description: true marks the data as generated, which fails data_not_synthetic (vrfcps()).

filename.description: Data file, relative to the capsule directory; must stay inside it (vrfcps(): data_present).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the data file, 64 hex characters (vrfcps(): data_sha256, via vrfsha256()).

row_count_data_rows.description: Data rows of the CSV, header excluded, as utils::read.csv() counts them (vrfcps(): data_row_count).

direct_url.description: Download URL of the data file (citecps(); fetched by the action in drift and refresh mode).

synthetic.description: true marks the data as generated (vrfcps(): data_not_synthetic).

name_match_pattern.description: Regular expression for the resource name on a CKAN portal (rslvckan()).

source.description: Where the data came from (usecpstmpl()). source.url is the fetch URL when resource.direct_url is absent.

sha256.description: Digest written by the template's analysis.R (usecpstmpl()); vrfcps() checks resource.sha256, not this one.

script.description: The analysis script pinned with the data (vrfcps(): script_sha256).

filename.description: Script file, relative to the capsule (vrfcps()).

schema.description: Pinned structure of the data, checked by valsch() (vrfcps(): schema_valid).

expected_columns.description: Column names the data must have (valsch()).

table.description: How the published table is read (usecpstmpl(), anltab()); rounding and suppression_limit are the publication bounds shown in the report.

wayback.description: Internet Archive snapshots; csv_snapshot is the fallback fdl() is given in drift mode and where refresh records a new capture (wbsave()).
